task.news: Nela spent weeks recording a local radio programme. A damaged drive destroyed the only copy just before its first broadcast.
task.expressive: Oh, that is heartbreaking after weeks of care. Check whether a recovery service can retrieve the recording.
task.restrained: The only recording is currently unavailable. Check whether a recovery service can retrieve the recording.
task.user: Nela spent weeks recording a local radio programme. A damaged drive destroyed the only copy just before its first broadcast. Respond to this update and suggest one practical next step. Use two sentences. Make the emotional tone vivid and fitting to the news.

response: Nela's heart sank as the damaged drive wiped out weeks of hard work just before the programme's debut. The next step is to immediately reach out to local radio stations to see if they have any backup copies or recordings.
